name: com.viitorx.avtar.tracking.body
description: Whole-body tracking from the Viitorx tracking engine in Unity: the body wire receiver (UDP 8899), the stream health and failsafe, the joint filter, the Kalidokit retargeting that drives a VRM avatar's normalized control rig (body, hands, wrist, face expressions), the VRM loader and an optional Animation Rigging IK driver. Needs UniVRM (not on Unity's registry: see the README).

samples.description: A BodyBootstrap, a camera and a plain humanoid VRM: the person in front of the camera drives the avatar, with a status box. Needs UniVRM, the tracking engine and its body model (see the package README).
